# NowBuild

> NowBuild is a 30-day agent growth team for solo founders and one-person companies. A founder provides one live product URL; the team researches the market, builds one shared campaign, selects the right channels, prepares daily work, and adjusts around execution and public feedback. The product being marketed does not need to be an AI product.

NowBuild is not a general-purpose copywriting box and does not promise fully autonomous posting. It connects product positioning, channel playbooks, weekly narratives, a daily content calendar, human review, publishing assistance, and public performance signals. The founder keeps final approval for every post and any step that requires account access, verification, or community-rule judgment.

## Best fit

- Solo founders, indie developers, and one-person companies with a live product or demonstrable MVP.
- Small SaaS products, AI tools, mobile apps, browser extensions, open-source projects, courses, templates, and lightweight consulting.
- Founders who can review and publish content for 15–30 minutes per day but do not want to invent a marketing plan from scratch.

## Core capabilities

- Product and audience analysis from one shared product profile.
- A connected 30-day campaign blueprint, daily action calendar, weekly reviews, and final cross-channel report.
- Social and owned-reach capabilities for X, LinkedIn, Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Moments, and direct outreach.
- Community and launch capabilities for Reddit, Hacker News, Indie Hackers, Product Hunt, GitHub, and developer publishing.
- Video and visual production packages for TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Shorts, Reels, carousels, and memes.
- Website conversion, SEO topic clusters, product-blog content, and long-form repurposing.
- Intelligent matching across 100+ product-launch directories, with automated form filling for 20 high-value destinations.
- Human review, conversational editing, publishing handoff, status tracking, and weekly adjustment.

## Pricing and availability

- Free preview: product profile, recommended channels, a first-week calendar, 10 matched directories, and one complete draft.
- 30-Day Agent Growth Team: $49 per month for one active product and one campaign at a time. It covers the launch-stage work normally split across research, strategy, social, community, video, visual, SEO, and product-distribution roles.
- A subscription may start one new 30-day campaign per billing cycle. AI generation and revisions are subject to reasonable-use limits.
- NowBuild prepares content and assists with forms; the user gives final approval for publishing, account access, payments, and directory submissions.
